findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_signup_link" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get the link for one offer from a comparison (electricity, savings or deposits). The link is the provider's own page unless the result says affiliate: true. Nothing about the user is sent." → after: "Get the link for one offer from a comparison (electricity, savings, deposits or current accounts). The link is the provider's own page unless the result says affiliate: true. Loans have no link: we don't arrange loans or link to lenders. Nothing about the user is sent."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
